name: @lenticule-science/lakota-language-algebra
description: lakota-language-algebra: Lakȟótiyapi (Lakota) as a language fiber — its lexicon, curated verb-stem morphology, reference, attachment and segmentation tables — presented as a live, discoverable, directly contractable micro-enterprise (a die) of linguistics-services-section.

scripts.check: for f in src/*.mjs test/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && tsc -p tsconfig.json
